message: <input type="search" name="q"> is labeled only by its title. Add a visible <label for="…">…</label> (WCAG 3.3.2).
<input type="checkbox" name="c"> has no label. Add <label for="…">…</label> or wrap it in a label (WCAG 1.3.1, 4.1.2).
placeholder doesn’t apply to <input type="checkbox">; it applies to type="text", type="search", type="tel", type="url", type="email", type="password", or type="number".
